detail: Archaeological survey records the west rocky ridge, two courtyards divided by the tall central tower, red granite and brick around later openings.
Åland conservation report documents the northern range, Kuretornet, roofed portions of the east range, open inner court and separate southern court, and the modern metal roof protections.
The original southwest keep is documented at roughly 18–20 metres. The medieval circuit developed two courts.
The project architect reports late twentieth-century conservation and the standing museum exterior.
